name: American Indian
note: About 42,000 served, 90% of them volunteers; 226 killed, about 0.4% of deaths against 0.4% of the population, one of the highest service rates of any group.
source: Defense Casualty Analysis System (DCAS), Vietnam Conflict Extract File, race field; US Census 1970; Guzmán 1969; Appy, Working-Class War (1993).
